doc_kind: coverage policy (medical coverage policy). Scope note: this document governs sedation and anesthesia for interventional pain procedures, NOT coverage of the facet injection itself.
lines_of_business: Health benefit plans administered by Cigna Companies (adults 18 and over); 'In certain markets, delegated vendor guidelines may be used'
effective_or_revised: Effective Date 9/15/2026; Next Review Date 2/15/2027; Coverage Policy Number 0551
sections_in_order: Coverage Policy (Moderate Sedation; Monitored Anesthesia Care)
Coding Information (Table 1 moderate sedation CPT, Table 2 interventional pain CPT, MAC codes, HCPCS, ICD-10 lists)
criteria_location: Coverage Policy, pp.2-4 of 29. Criteria are two lists (moderate sedation, MAC), each 'EITHER of the following': (a) a procedure that requires immobility, or (b) BOTH a named procedure AND a patient risk factor. Everything else is code tables (pp.4-25) and background.
procedures_covered: Moderate sedation (99152, 99153, 99156, 99157) during interventional pain procedures
Monitored anesthesia care (anesthesia CPT 01937 onward) during interventional pain procedures. Facet joint injection (64490-64495) is only on the list of procedures the sedation may accompany.

logic.top_level: any: EITHER immobility-required procedure OR (listed procedure AND risk factor)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Fall-through: 'not covered or reimbursable for ANY other indication, including the following: trigger point injection, peripheral joint injection'; for MAC also 'when no anesthetic is administered'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: considered medically necessary when EITHER of the following criteria is met: The interventional pain procedure requires the individual to remain motionless for a prolonged period of time or in a painful position ... BOTH of the following criteria are met: ANY of the following interventional pain procedures is being performed ... severe anxiety ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Nesting EITHER > BOTH > ANY is conveyed by indentation and bullets only; flattened text loses it. In the moderate sedation block the second BOTH member is a single risk (severe anxiety/psychiatric/cognitive), whereas in MAC it is an ANY-of 8 risk groups.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: presence of ANY of the following: increased risk for complications due to ASA physical status III or above*; ANY of the following comorbidities ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Nested ANY inside ANY; asterisk footnote says 'The presence of a stable, treated condition, of itself, is not necessarily sufficient to support the need for MAC.'

and_or_ambiguity.quote: severe cardiac disease and/or pulmonary disease (e.g., severe hypotension [systolic < 90 mm Hg], major cardiac dysfunction)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' with examples that are not thresholds.

requirement_kinds.quote: The interventional pain procedure requires the individual to remain motionless for a prolonged period of time or in a painful position (e.g., sympathetic blocks, plexus blocks, radiofrequency ablation procedures...)

severe anxiety under active medical management with psychotropic medication and/or cognitive therapy, or other severe psychiatric condition(s), or severe cognitive impairment(s)

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Table 1 moderate sedation codes and Table 2 interventional pain codes are separate lists; coverage is 'when criteria in the applicable policy statements listed above are met'. Table 2 includes facet codes 64490-64495 (alongside epidural, SI, nerve root). ICD-10 lists (dementia, epilepsy, etc.) support the risk factors. Anesthesia code tables run on pp.7-25.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: No code is tagged non-covered; non-covered is by indication ('not covered or reimbursable for ANY other indication').

extraction_hazards: Nested EITHER/BOTH/ANY bullets with indentation only; a flat parse yields wrong logic.
Footnote asterisk for ASA table is placed after the nested list and the ASA I-VI list sits inside the criteria text.
Policy text is only pp.2-4; 25 further pages are code tables (including hundreds of ICD-10 rows) that look like criteria lists.
Slight disagreements between criteria and background (MELD > 10 vs MELD ≥ 10; BMI >= 40 vs > 40; CKD wording) so extraction from the wrong section changes thresholds.
Page headers 'Medical Coverage Policy: 0551' interrupt lists.
interesting_structures: Ancillary-service policy: facet injection appears only as a trigger in a list of procedures for which sedation can be justified.
EITHER (procedure-driven) OR (procedure AND patient risk) double structure, with a long ANY of risk factors for MAC.
Companion-policy design: the facet injection criteria live in separate Cigna policies not included here.
Fall-through denial for unlisted indications (trigger point, peripheral joint).

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: As a tree it is clean (any of: immobility procedure; all of procedure-listed and any-of risk). But it does not answer whether a facet injection is covered; using it as the facet guideline would be a category error. Leaves such as BMI, eGFR and MELD are measurable.
